title: Run the Stack
style: fast beat, phonk, big band brass, female lead vocal, tactical energy, call and response, driving groove, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[Intro]

(spoken)

You don't have to play where you land.

Stack it.

Own every forehand.

[Verse 1]

Serve and slide, stack to the left

Partner covers right, nothing gets past

Signal before the serve goes out

Both players moving, no room for doubt

Strong side forehands covering the court

No more backhand jammed, that's the report

Stack formation changes the whole game

Both players dominant, that's the aim

[Pre-Chorus]

Why let the weaker side take the middle ball

Stack it so the strongest arm takes all

Position over placement every time

RUN THE STACK AND OWN THE LINE

[Chorus]

RUN THE STACK

BOTH FOREHANDS IN THE MIDDLE

RUN THE STACK

SIGNAL BEFORE YOU SERVE

RUN THE STACK

NO BACKHAND IN THE DANGER

RUN THE STACK

YOU OWN WHAT YOU DESERVE

[Verse 2]

Return and stack, partner slides wide

You cover the middle from the right side

Communicate the signal before the point

Eyes together, nothing out of joint

If they read the stack, switch it back

Keep them guessing, that's the attack

Cover the middle when you read the drive

RUN THE STACK TO STAY ALIVE

[Bridge]

(spoken)

Here's how stacking works.

After the serve, the server slides to the preferred side.

The partner moves to cover the other.

Signal with your paddle behind your back, stay or go.

The goal is to always have your strongest forehand covering the middle.

Because the middle ball wins or loses the point.

Stack it. Cover it. Own it.

[Final Chorus]

RUN THE STACK

BOTH FOREHANDS IN THE MIDDLE

RUN THE STACK

SIGNAL BEFORE YOU SERVE

RUN THE STACK

NO BACKHAND IN THE DANGER

RUN THE STACK

YOU OWN WHAT YOU DESERVE

RUN THE STACK

COVER THE MIDDLE EVERY TIME

RUN THE STACK

THAT IS THE WINNING SIGN

[Outro]

(spoken)

Signal.

Slide.

Cover the middle.

Run the stack.

Every point.
